## Summary

`npx sofar.sh` failed with "could not determine executable to run" on every release since 0.34.0. The package has two bins (sofar, sofar-core) and none named after the package, so npx cannot choose one. Added a `sofar.sh` bin alias for dist/cli.js, and packaging.test.ts now pins it. Proven: published 0.34.1 fails with a clean cache, the packed tarball resolves and runs. Ships in the next publish. Until then the workaround is `npx -p sofar.sh sofar`.
